items.title: Eicher Motors Q1 Results: Profit jumps 21% to Rs 1,462 crore
items.summary: Eicher Motors has announced an impressive 21.4 percent rise in profits for the first quarter. Royal Enfield has set a new benchmark with its highest quarterly sales volume to date. The company is also investing Rs 1,225 crore in a new greenfield facility in Andhra Pradesh, aimed at significantly boosting motorcycle production capacity. Additionally, VE Commercial Vehicles has reported strong sales figures for the same quarter.

items.summary: Korean retail investors have racked up heavy losses from leveraged bets on stocks, following rule changes earlier this year.

items.summary: Waaree Energies has reported a profit increase of 15.39 percent for the June quarter, fueled by higher revenues that bolstered its financial performance. Notably, the company boasts a record order book of around Rs 61,500 crore. Additionally, module production experienced a remarkable year-on-year rise of 41.51 percent, while emerging business ventures are now making a significant impact on total revenue.

items.title: BMW layoffs: 8,000 desk jobs to be axed — what is forcing German automaker to hit the brakes?
items.summary: The severance plan, agreed upon with BMW’s works council, will primarily affect administrative and development roles, while production workers will not be impacted.

items.title: SML Mahindra to acquire M&M's truck, bus business for unified CV company
items.summary: SML Mahindra will acquire Mahindra & Mahindra's truck and bus division. This move aims to consolidate commercial vehicle operations under one entity. The transaction is expected to be completed within this fiscal year. Combined operations will unlock manufacturing and technology synergies for growth. Future capital expenditure plans will focus on capacity and product expansion.

items.title: Vedanta Iron and Steel reports Rs 122 crore net profit in Q1
items.summary: Vedanta Iron and Steel Ltd posted a Rs 122 crore net profit for the June quarter. This marks a significant turnaround from the Rs 142 crore net loss incurred last year. The company's revenue from operations increased to Rs 3,662 crore during this period. These earnings represent the first results after its demerger from Vedanta Ltd. The company operates integrated steel and mining assets across key mineral belts.

items.title: L&T bets Rs 5,000 crore on a new electronics business, targets $4.85 bn market
items.summary: Larsen & Toubro is investing Rs 5,000 crore over five years in a new electronic products business. This new venture aims to expand manufacturing and research capabilities for future growth. The company expects its addressable market to more than double by 2031. Mobility will be a key growth pillar, developing electric vehicle components and systems. L&T will leverage technology partnerships before building proprietary products for markets.

items.summary: Vedanta Power has posted a standalone loss of Rs 449 crore for the June quarter, albeit with total income rising to Rs 1,844 crore in the first fiscal quarter. Power sales saw a significant boost of 38 percent year-on-year, attributed to improved generation from essential assets. The company envisions expanding its capacity to 20 GW by FY33, aiming to rank among the top three private power sector players.

items.title: US Stocks: US market opens lower ahead of Fed decision; chip stocks wobble
items.summary: Major stock indexes on Wall Street opened lower on Wednesday. Investors awaited the Federal Reserve's monetary policy decision amid Middle East tensions. Chip stocks also faced pressure ahead of Big Tech earnings later this week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 73.1 points at the open. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite also saw declines.

items.summary: Karnataka Bank reported a 43% year-on-year rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 419 crore, driven by stronger business growth, improved asset quality and lower provisions. Net interest income, operating profit and margins increased, while advances and deposits posted healthy year-on-year growth.

items.summary: The second trial release of the Index of Services Production showed broad-based growth across formal services, offering policymakers and investors a new monthly gauge of activity in the economy's largest sector.

items.summary: Investors claim Novo Nordisk misled the market about CagriSema's tolerability, after disappointing clinical trial results wiped billions off its market cap.

items.title: Manipal Health Enterprises IPO off to slow start, subscribed 15% on opening day; retail portion booked 27%
items.summary: Manipal Health Enterprises' IPO saw a sluggish start, being subscribed 0.15 times on Day 1, with retail and non-institutional portions lagging. The company raised ₹4,167 crore from anchor investors. The total issue size is ₹9,275 crore, with shares listing on August 5.

items.title: Copper slips ahead of Fed rate decision, aluminium rises on Gulf fighting
items.summary: Copper prices faced a downturn due to cautious trading leading up to the Federal Reserve's imminent interest rate decision. The easing of supply constraints in China added further downward pressure on both copper and zinc. Conversely, aluminium experienced an uptick as escalating conflicts in the Middle East raised supply concerns.

items.title: US Treasury yields rise after three-day fall as oil jumps, Fed decision looms
items.summary: As oil prices surged, treasury yields took notice, raising inflation worries in the market. Traders are keeping a watchful eye on the Federal Reserve's expected decision to maintain interest rates today. Nonetheless, traders are fully anticipating a hike in September, with a solid possibility of another increase before the year's end.

items.title: Gold loan portfolio to jump to ₹30 lakh crore by March 2028: Report

items.title: Higher crude oil prices could hit India's fiscal health, finance ministry says
items.summary: India's finance ministry warns of rising crude oil prices impacting fiscal and trade balances. Persistent geopolitical tensions in West Asia present key risks to the nation's economy. The country's external sector remains resilient, supported by strong exports and services trade. Foreign exchange reserves stand at $675.2 billion, offering a significant buffer.

items.title: Euro zone bonds snap three-day rally, yields rise with oil
items.summary: As oil prices surged on Wednesday, Euro zone government bonds experienced a decline. Heightened hostilities in the Middle East were a major factor driving Brent crude upward. Economists are keenly observing energy trends for signs of inflation that might influence monetary policy changes, contributing to traders’ nervousness surrounding the upcoming interest rate announcement from the US Federal Reserve.

items.title: How cow showers and fans help farmers keep cattle cool
items.summary: Dairy farmers are using cow showers and fans to protect cattle as hotter summers hit milk production.

items.title: India bonds slip as oil prices hurt; Fed verdict in focus
items.summary: On Wednesday, Indian government bonds took a hit due to renewed U.S. airstrikes in the Middle East, escalating tensions in the Gulf region. This escalation has led to a spike in oil prices and increased U.S. Treasury yields. The rising crude prices pose challenges for India's inflation, fiscal health, and current account. Investors can expect high global yields to continue, limiting the potential for rallies in Indian fixed income markets.

items.title: Cognizant forecasts weak quarterly revenue amid cautious client spending
items.summary: Cognizant Technology has revised its third-quarter revenue projections, now falling short of Wall Street's expectations. The cautious stance of clients regarding discretionary IT expenditures and significant investments is evident. With AI adoption gaining momentum, enterprises are focusing more on data center infrastructures than software. The company anticipates its annual revenue will land between $22.04 billion and $22.35 billion, after reporting second-quarter earnings of $5.48 billion, aligning with forecasts.

items.title: IRDAI approves Patanjali, DS Group's acquisition of Magma General Insurance
items.summary: Patanjali Ayurved and Dharampal Satyapal Group secured IRDAI approval for Magma General Insurance. This acquisition marks Patanjali's significant entry into the financial services sector. Patanjali will acquire a majority stake, while DS Group will become a co-investor. Magma General Insurance has shown strong premium growth and achieved profitability. Patanjali plans to expand the insurer's product offerings and reach across India.

items.title: India-Nepal trade gets boost as first direct freight train reaches Biratnagar
items.summary: India and Nepal have made strides in trade with the commencement of a direct commercial container freight train service connecting Kolkata Port to Biratnagar Customs Yard. The first train carried forty tank wagons filled with canola oil, marking a crucial development that promises to slash transit durations and reduce logistics costs. This collaboration is a testament to their growing economic union.

items.title: 'Biggest nightmare': Nithin Kamath warns MTF boom could worsen selloff in small and midcap stocks
items.summary: Zerodha co-founder Nithin Kamath warned that rapid growth in margin trading funding could amplify market downturns, especially in small- and mid-cap stocks. He cautioned that forced selling, liquidity constraints and rising leverage may intensify losses despite SEBI’s safeguards.

items.title: Pidilite Industries among 7 commodity stocks to hit 52-week highs and surge up to 25% in a month
items.summary: Six BSE Commodities Index stocks touched fresh 52-week highs as Sensex surged 972 points. Oriental Aromatics, Lloyds Metals, Tanfac Industries, Sudeep Pharma, Yasho Industries and Pidilite Industries gained on sustained buying interest, signalling strong investor confidence and bullish market momentum.

items.summary: Indian benchmark indices rallied over 1% as Sensex climbed 889 points and Nifty crossed 24,250, adding Rs 4 lakh crore in market value. Strong IIP data, optimism over FII inflows and gains in IT and metal stocks outweighed rising geopolitical tensions and oil prices.

items.title: Large-scale electronics PLI catalyses Rs 96,000 cr investment in mobile manufacturing: MoS IT
items.summary: Production-linked schemes have driven significant investment in India's electronics manufacturing sector. Mobile production alone has seen approximately Rs 96,000 crore in new investments. Electronics production grew by 15.8 percent year-on-year, reaching Rs 13.11 lakh crore. Smartphones now lead India's exports, surpassing traditional commodities like gems and jewellery. These initiatives are creating substantial direct and indirect employment opportunities across the nation.

items.title: Quote of the day by Lou Simpson: "One of the things I have learned over the years is how important management is in building or subtracting from value"
items.summary: Legendary investor Lou Simpson emphasised that management quality is central to long-term investing success. Effective leaders allocate capital wisely, execute strategy, uphold governance and create shareholder value, while poor leadership can erode competitive advantages and weaken even fundamentally strong businesses.

items.title: Texmaco, TrinityRail and Touax to invest Rs 2000 crore to boost rail lease business
items.summary: Three companies will invest Rs 2,000 crore over three years for new wagons. This investment will procure approximately 6,500 wagons for private leasing operations. TrinityRail Global joins the existing joint venture with a significant stake. The government's liberalized wagon design policy enables this expansion. This move aims to meet immediate demand for around 30,000 new wagon units.

items.title: Consumer court junks plea against airline, 'enforcing baggage limit, check-in deadline no deficiency in service'
items.summary: A consumer commission dismissed a passenger's complaint against Brussels Airlines. The passenger refused to pay excess baggage fees and missed the check-in deadline. The commission stated airlines are not guilty of service deficiency for enforcing standard contractual conditions. Timelines are fundamental operational requirements in commercial aviation for all passengers. Consequences from a passenger's own failure do not establish deficiency in service.

items.title: Dabur Q1 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 591 crore; revenue up 11%

Demand from tier-2 cities and beyond shows growing interest in premium foldable devices. Samsung expects these new foldables to match its S26 lineup pre-order numbers.

items.title: The Falcon by Dalcore sets new benchmark for branded luxury living on Gurugram’s Golf Course Road
items.summary: India's luxury housing market is evolving beyond traditional approaches. The Falcon project in Gurugram offers a new vision for affluent homebuyers. This development emphasizes global design, privacy, and exclusive living experiences. It caters to discerning buyers seeking curated and lifestyle-focused residences. The project reflects a growing demand for branded and thoughtfully designed homes.

items.title: Six in ten Indian companies believe AI to play a significant role: PWC
items.summary: Indian manufacturers anticipate artificial intelligence significantly aiding strategic goals within five years. This optimism surpasses global counterparts regarding productivity and long-term growth potential. Automation adoption is led by data capture and analytics, followed by quality assurance. However, India lags in developing homegrown manufacturing capabilities and faces an MSME technology gap. Coherent integration of manufacturing capabilities will distinguish the Indian economy's future.
